## Panel B — Mitochondrial volume quantification

**BLOCKED — awaiting data from Ying Xie (Cellpose segmentation masks /
MitoGraph per-cell output).**

Analysis code for this panel is in `analyses/mito_volume.Rmd`.
Once the segmentation data is received, run that script from the repo root
to generate `analyses/output/mito_volume_per_cellvol.pdf`, then update
this section with the final plot code.

The analysis plan (per reviewer response):
1. From each Cellpose mask: extract cell area and major/minor axis lengths.
2. Estimate cell volume assuming a prolate ellipsoid geometry (state assumption in Methods).
3. Compute MitoGraph mitochondrial volume / cell volume per cell.
4. Plot per-cell distributions (boxplot) for WT vs rim15Δ in C and P starvation.
5. Run the same paired test as the original Fig 5B to confirm the reduction persists
   after normalization.
